notes.title: Developer Livestream
notes.content: Join our livestream with the developers. We will be playing through the Demo version and will be able to answer your questions.

notes.title: To Your Stations! Quick Pitch
notes.content:
To Your Stations! is a couch co-op spaceship management game where you work with your friends to fend off an alien horde. In this demo, you will be able to play through 5 levels on the first ship available in the game, the Hendricks. In the full game, several different ships will be available, each with a completely different layout and playstyle. 

[b]Note:[/b] The game only has local multiplayer, so if you want to play with people who aren’t right next to you, you will have to use Steam Remote Play Together or a program like Parsec. 

We hope you enjoy the demo!

- The Orbital Contingent Team
